name: Cadillac
verdict: Cadillac is a vehicle brand of General Motors, a US-listed carmaker whose 2026 proxy security-ownership table discloses only BlackRock (8.3%) and State Street (5.2%) above 5%. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: General Motors is a US-listed company (NYSE: GM); its 2026 proxy security-ownership table names only BlackRock (8.3%) and State Street (5.2%) among holders above 5%.
